status: proposed design choices; not owner effect decisions

choices.title: Separate successor package
choices.choice: Implement proposed implementation/define-cli/v2; keep v1 and552-row exact manifest/protocol unchanged. Switch launcher only at exact successor adoption.
choices.rationale: Avoid inheriting unrelated file changes or silently invalidating old consumer evidence.

choices.title: Explicit selected Host Port
choices.choice: Target API17 protocol via exact runtime profile; current maintained reference is operator revision3 with capture5/family5. Base-only read preparation is allowed only if actual selected catalog/permissions suffice.
choices.rationale: Avoid direct v2 hardpin and latest-directory discovery; preserve actual host caller/branch boundaries.

choices.title: Python owns new record semantics and byte integrity
choices.choice: Thin JavaScript interaction/delegation; Python single-read strict decoder/resolver/kernel/exporter/materializer. Preserve opaque original authority bytes and host-defined digest domains.
choices.rationale: Close hash/parse TOCTOU and cross-runtime numeric/encoding ambiguity without changing legacy numeric Calculations.

choices.title: Pack first and explicit materialization
choices.choice: Keep task-local proposed meanings, values, applications and optional assessments embedded. Only selected reusable meanings become full Definition/v2 targets.
choices.rationale: Prevent task-per-Definition proliferation and accidental shared authority.

choices.title: No invented parameter contract
choices.choice: Use exact semantic declaration/qualified mechanical mapping; context fields remain metadata unless declared parameters. Missing contract remains an open obligation.
choices.rationale: Preserve selected meaning and reject hidden tolerance/account/Work parameter extensions.

choices.title: Assessment import, no domain execution
choices.choice: Verify imported assessment application/input/evidence/method/producer/standing; retain unverified posture where allowed. Domain Method execution belongs to separately authorized Work/host Action.
choices.rationale: A saved result or schema PASS is not executed Evaluation or accepted fact.

choices.title: Existing review and governing publisher
choices.choice: Translate selected outputs to existing change.prepare/change.validate/proposal.review; independent human/native owner effects and host application remain separate.
choices.rationale: No second owner identity system, governing store, signer or invented human Decision.

choices.title: All-or-nothing review cohort
choices.choice: Freeze explicit dependency-closed selected members under current single-checkpoint profile. Partial/new selection creates new cohort and affected review.
choices.rationale: Do not apply unsupported partial effects or transfer whole-package approval to changed inputs.

choices.title: Existing durable Source/Evidence/Work retention
choices.choice: Where qualified and selected, retain immutable Pack bytes through host custody plus existing Source/v1, Evidence Set/v1 and Work refs; no independent Pack Artifact Type.
choices.rationale: Durable task knowledge without admitting embedded proposed meanings or creating per-application artifacts.

choices.title: One immutable epoch and selected current pointer
choices.choice: Host/provider resolves all current material through exact selected epoch; old registry mirrors are derived compatibility surfaces. Existing representation/consumer changes require their own qualification.
choices.rationale: Prevent mixed State/vocabulary/profile epochs and future/self-referential receipts.

choices.title: Snapshot POC before live integration
choices.choice: L0 proves exact executable local preparation on explicit public frozen snapshot; L1 proves real current authorized host preparation; L2 review; L3 governing publication and realization.
choices.rationale: Useful progress without labelling a snapshot/fixture as live native qualification.

choices.title: Preserve legacy consumers and explicit new limits
choices.choice: Delegate existing commands to v1; new Pack compile is unsupported. Reuse prior limits plus explicit bounded application/assessment counts and stricter host budgets.
choices.rationale: Avoid accidental protocol migration, loss of numeric behavior or hidden resource/performance claims.
